verses.en: By the Daybreak,
by the Ten Nights,
by the even and the odd,
by the passing night––
is this oath strong enough for a rational person?
verses.ar: هَلْ فِى ذَٰلِكَ قَسَمٌ لِّذِى حِجْرٍ

verses.en: Have you [Prophet] considered how your Lord dealt with [the people] of 'Ad,
verses.ar: أَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِعَادٍ

verses.en: of Iram, [the city] of lofty pillars,
whose like has never been made in any land,
verses.ar: ٱلَّتِى لَمْ يُخْلَقْ مِثْلُهَا فِى ٱلْبِلَـٰدِ

verses.en: and the Thamud, who hewed into the rocks in the valley,
and the mighty and powerful Pharaoh?
All of them committed excesses in their lands,
and spread corruption there:
your Lord let a scourge of punishment loose on them.
Your Lord is always watchful.
[The nature of] man is that, when his Lord tries him through honour and blessings, he says, ‘My Lord has honoured me,’
verses.ar: فَأَمَّا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ إِذَا مَا ٱبْتَلَىٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ فَأَكْرَمَهُۥ وَنَعَّمَهُۥ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّىٓ أَكْرَمَنِ

verses.en: but when He tries him through the restriction of his provision, he says, ‘My Lord has humiliated me.’
verses.ar: وَأَمَّآ إِذَا مَا ٱبْتَلَىٰهُ فَقَدَرَ عَلَيْهِ رِزْقَهُۥ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّىٓ أَهَـٰنَنِ

verses.en: No indeed! You [people] do not honour orphans,
you do not urge one another to feed the poor,
you consume inheritance greedily,
and you love wealth with a passion.
No indeed! When the earth is pounded to dust, pounded and pounded,
verses.ar: كَلَّآ إِذَا دُكَّتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ دَكًّا دَكًّا

verses.en: when your Lord comes with the angels, rank upon rank,
when Hell is that Day brought near- on that Day man will take heed, but what good will that be to him then?
verses.ar: وَجِا۟ىٓءَ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بِجَهَنَّمَ ۚ يَوْمَئِذٍ يَتَذَكَّرُ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ وَأَنَّىٰ لَهُ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ

verses.en: He will say, ‘Would that I had provided for this life to come!’
On that Day, no one will punish as He punishes,
and no one will bind as He binds.
‘[But] you, soul at peace:
return to your Lord well pleased and well pleasing;
go in among My servants;
and into My Garden.’
